sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).

findings.why: The current ASL is the complete controlled list for TO1/STL. Meccanica C has no approval for BR-220, since approvals are per part, plant and customer. Its approvals for BR-180 and BR-310 do not carry over. PRC-DEV-007 also says a deviation does not approve a new source.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the Stellantis CSR. Switching the billet source from Alluminio B to Meccanica C is a material source change. It needs a risk analysis and written Stellantis approval before shipment. No approval in force covers it.

sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
A material-related contribution has not been excluded.
Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).

findings.why: Meccanica C has an open 8D for fastener-hole cracks on 6xxx alloy brackets. A material contribution is not excluded. BR-220 is 6082-T6, also 6xxx, and has 4 fastener holes, with no cracks or tears visible at 10x required by the drawing. The 2026-11-05 email confirms the 8D is still open.

sources.quote: Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
per il BR-220 il materiale è EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The email relies on Rev B (6061-T6, 240 MPa), which is superseded and withdrawn. Drawing Rev C and control plan CP-BR220-R3 require EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). The 6061-T6 billet that Meccanica C is approved for (on BR-180) does not meet the drawing in force.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: No certificate or tensile result for any Meccanica C billet is in the documents. This means there is no evidence of EN AW-6082-T6 or of Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). Someone must say whether Meccanica C can supply 6082-T6 and a 3.1 certificate.
